Al-Azhar University – Gaza

📍 Gaza City, Gaza
University Gaza Operational

Al-Azhar University – Gaza, founded in 1991, is one of the largest universities in the Gaza Strip. It is administratively independent from Al-Azhar in Egypt and offers a wide range of programmes including medicine, engineering, sciences, and Islamic studies. It was a major employer of academic staff across the Gaza governorates.

📅 2025-08-09 Direct Strike (Vicinity) INC-037
A building near the University was hit and destroyed, the hit came after the issuing of a displacement order the same day.

On 8 September, a displacement order was issued for a 12-storey commercial building and the surrounding blocks and IDP tents, near Al Azahar University in Ar Rimal, in central Gaza city. The order covered one square kilometre in one neighbourhood. On the same day, the building was hit and destroyed, causing severe damage to the area.

📅 2023-12-07 Demolition INC-041
Al-Mughraqa Campus of Al-Azhar University was demolished by Israeli forces after the soldiers had used it to store munitions and hold religious services

Israeli security forces also demolished part of the Al-Azhar University’s Al-Mughraqa campus. The Commission established that Israeli security forces had targeted the campus at least three times between 26 October and 7 December 2023. On 7 December 2023, Israeli security forces demolished the Faculty of Arts and Human Sciences building and the AlRiyadh Auditorium building through controlled demolitions. The Commission identified those involved in the demolition as soldiers belonging to the 749th Combat Engineering Battalion. Images and videos depicting Israeli soldiers dancing and freely moving at the site, and satellite imagery analysis showing cars parked at the site, have led the Commission to conclude on reasonable grounds that there was no significant threat to Israeli security forces in the area and therefore no military necessity to demolish the university buildings. Incidents of the demolition of educational facilities have been filmed by Israeli soldiers. Footage depicts them expressing celebratory or demeaning comments and jokes during or after demolitions. In one example, an Israeli soldier says in Hebrew: “For all those asking why there is no education in Gaza, oops a missile fell on you, that sucks, too bad. That is how you will not be engineers anymore.”16 A caption to the posted video reads: “In the university of the terrorists.” The Commission verified the Israeli security forces’ seizure of Al-Azhar University’s Al-Mughraqa campus in November 2023 and the forces’ occupation of the campus to 7 December 2023. Evidence collected and verified by the Commission indicated that Israeli security forces had used the campus to store munitions, vehicles and other military equipment; that religious services were provided to soldiers in an area of the building that Israeli security forces had transformed into a synagogue with a dedicated plaque; and that a Mezuzah18 had been fixed on the entrance to the building.

Sources: 🔗 docs 🔗 voices 🔗 gazaeducationsector

📅 2023-04-11 Bombardment INC-010
The campus was bombed leading to the destruction of most of the campus

On November 4, 2023, the Israeli Occupation warplanes targeted Al-Azhar University campus in al-Maghraqa, east of Gaza City, and almost destroyed the campus as a whole... The Faculty of Agriculture's farm in Beit Hanoun was destroyed, and the Haider Abdel Shafi Medical School building in Tal al-Hawa was partially damaged... The West Campus faculties suffered significant damage... (Palestine Studies, Al-Azhar). A policy paper published by the Institute for Palestine Studies states "On October 26 and again on November 4, Israeli military aircraft bombed the buildings of Al-Azhar University. These bombings occurred while a large number of civilians had taken refuge there. At least 12 people were reportedly killed and more than 50 wounded, while rescue teams were searching for survivors under the rubble." The source cited for this information is Top War (a.k.a. Military Review), which is not considered highly reliable, and no other news agencies reported casualties at Al-Azhar on 26 Oct of 4 Nov.

Sources: 🔗 gazaeducationsector 🔗 scholarsatrisk 📜 the%20university%20had%20been%20destroye 🔗 voices 🔗 en 🔗 palestine-studies

📅 13/05/2024 00:00 Unspecified INC-049
A video taken by an IDF soldiers showing the destruction of Al-Azhar University starts circulating on social media

An IDF soldier posted a video walking around the campus of Al-Azhar, showing the destruction and joking about the university being under construction and classes starting never. It is not clear exactly when the video was taken or what incident created the damage that was shown.

INC-007📅 2023-04-11Airstrike
×

University campus virtually destroyed

📍 Al-Azhar University – Gaza — Gaza City, Gaza

Full description

Warplanes targeted Al-Azhar University campus in al-Maghraqa, east of Gaza City, and almost destroyed the campus as a whole. This campus has two main buildings: the first houses the Faculties of Arts and Humanities, Sharia, and Education, and the second houses the King Hassan II Building, which includes the Faculties of Agriculture, Veterinary Medicine, and Law. Additionally, the campus has laboratories and the University's radio and television station. The Faculty of Agriculture's farm in Beit Hanoun was destroyed, and the Haider Abdel Shafi Medical School building in Tal al-Hawa was partially damaged.

Summary

Strike on Al-Azhar University's new buildings in al-Mughraqa in the southern Gaza Strip
